parsed.reason: Both describe stale heap entries left behind when an item is discarded or re-added, so the old timestamp/position is used and the re-added item is evicted early. Description A focuses on the removed _is_current check and pop() accepting stale entries; Description B additionally covers purge() reading the heap top without validation and the revoked-task consequence. The core root cause (stale heap entries not invalidated, causing premature eviction of re-added items) is the same.
